thing-type.label: Apple TV
thing-type.description: An Apple TV (tvOS) controlled over AirPlay and Companion, including the MediaRemote tunnel.

parameter.name: macAddress
parameter.label: Identifier
parameter.description: Unique device identifier (MAC). Set automatically by discovery.

parameter.name: host
parameter.label: Host
parameter.description: IP address of the Apple TV. Populated and kept current by discovery; set manually only for a static IP or a device on a different subnet.

parameter.name: name
parameter.label: Name
parameter.description: Friendly name presented to the device while pairing.

parameter.name: airplayPin
parameter.label: AirPlay Pairing PIN
parameter.description: PIN shown on the Apple TV for the AirPlay pairing step. Enter it to pair AirPlay (now-playing metadata and streaming).

parameter.name: companionPin
parameter.label: Companion Pairing PIN
parameter.description: PIN shown on the Apple TV for the Companion pairing step. After AirPlay is paired the device shows a new, different PIN; enter it to pair Companion (remote, power and apps).

parameter.name: airplayCredentials
parameter.label: AirPlay Credentials
parameter.description: Credentials obtained by pairing AirPlay. Populated automatically after pairing.

parameter.name: companionCredentials
parameter.label: Companion Credentials
parameter.description: Credentials obtained by pairing Companion. Populated automatically after pairing.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Fallback polling interval in seconds (0 disables; live push updates are used otherwise).

thing-type.label: AirPlay Speaker
thing-type.description: An AirPlay/RAOP audio device such as a HomePod or third-party AirPlay speaker.

parameter.name: macAddress
parameter.label: Identifier
parameter.description: Unique device identifier (MAC). Set automatically by discovery.

parameter.name: host
parameter.label: Host
parameter.description: IP address of the speaker. Populated and kept current by discovery; set manually only for a static IP or a device on a different subnet.

parameter.name: name
parameter.label: Name
parameter.description: Friendly name presented to the device while pairing.

parameter.name: airplayPin
parameter.label: AirPlay Pairing PIN
parameter.description: PIN shown on the speaker for the AirPlay pairing step (for devices that require pairing).

parameter.name: raopPin
parameter.label: RAOP Pairing PIN
parameter.description: PIN shown on the speaker for the RAOP audio pairing step (for devices that require pairing).

parameter.name: airplayCredentials
parameter.label: AirPlay Credentials
parameter.description: Credentials obtained by pairing AirPlay. Populated automatically after pairing.

parameter.name: raopCredentials
parameter.label: RAOP Credentials
parameter.description: Credentials obtained by pairing RAOP audio. Populated automatically after pairing.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Fallback polling interval in seconds (0 disables; live push updates are used otherwise).

channel-type.label: Remote Key
channel-type.description: Sends a remote-control button press.

channel-type.label: Title
channel-type.description: Title of the media currently playing.

channel-type.label: Artist
channel-type.description: Artist of the media currently playing.

channel-type.label: Album
channel-type.description: Album of the media currently playing.

channel-type.label: Genre
channel-type.description: Genre of the media currently playing.

channel-type.label: Media Type
channel-type.description: Type of the media currently playing.

channel-type.label: Playback State
channel-type.description: Current playback state.

channel-type.label: Position
channel-type.description: Playback position of the current media. Send a value to seek.

channel-type.label: Duration
channel-type.description: Total length of the current media.

channel-type.label: Progress
channel-type.description: Playback progress as a percentage.

channel-type.label: Shuffle
channel-type.description: Shuffle mode.

channel-type.label: Repeat
channel-type.description: Repeat mode.

channel-type.label: Series Name
channel-type.description: Name of the TV series currently playing.

channel-type.label: Season Number
channel-type.description: Season number of the TV series currently playing.

channel-type.label: Episode Number
channel-type.description: Episode number of the TV series currently playing.

channel-type.label: Content Identifier
channel-type.description: Identifier of the content currently playing.

channel-type.label: iTunes Store Identifier
channel-type.description: iTunes Store identifier of the content currently playing.

channel-type.label: Artwork
channel-type.description: Artwork of the media currently playing.

channel-type.label: App
channel-type.description: Bundle identifier of the foreground app. Send a value to launch an app.

channel-type.label: App Name
channel-type.description: Name of the foreground app.

channel-type.label: User Account
channel-type.description: Switches the active user account.

channel-type.label: Output Devices
channel-type.description: Comma-separated identifiers of the active AirPlay output devices. Send a list to set them.

channel-type.label: Output Device Volume
channel-type.description: Sets the volume of a single output device, formatted as "identifier=level" (level 0-100).

channel-type.label: Keyboard Input
channel-type.description: Text of the focused input field. Send a value to set the text (empty clears it).

channel-type.label: Keyboard Focus
channel-type.description: Whether a text input field is currently focused.

channel-type.label: Touch Gesture
channel-type.description: Performs a trackpad gesture. Formats: "click", "swipe:x1,y1,x2,y2,ms", "action:x,y,mode".

channel-type.label: Play URL
channel-type.description: Streams a video URL to the device via AirPlay.

channel-type.label: Stream URL
channel-type.description: Streams an audio URL or file to the device via AirPlay/RAOP.
